'''O6-D5''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] that operated during the time of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The droid was sent to [[CZ-198]] as a mission courier carrying a call for recruitment into the [[Dread War]] for Republic strike forces operating in the area.<ref name="TOR" />
